verification.method: scripts/verify/rankings-population.py reads the original UN WPP 2024 file and interim update directly (not the site's generated data) and compares the built pages and CSVs; assertClaim stops the build if a sentence stops being true; scripts/check-pop-rankings.mjs checks page = data = ItemList = CSV on every build; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every table row (237 countries or areas: order, rank, people per km²), every CSV row, and every figure and claim in the text: five most crowded; 13 above 1,000 per km² and the four of them above one million people; Bangladesh first among countries above ten million (more than twice the next), ahead of India among the 16 above 100 million, ninth overall, land area, 1950/2050 density; Greenland and the Falklands below one per km²; Mongolia, Australia, Namibia, Canada least dense above one million; world density 1950/2026/2050/2100
verification.against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…), downloaded 2026-11-25; licence CC BY 3.0 IGO
verification.result: All 1,239 independent comparisons across both pages matched; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show; disputed areas use the UN's own names

changelog.note: First version: UN World Population Prospects 2024 figures for 2026.
